name: 23669 · Hampton, VA
findings: ZIP 23669 (Hampton) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23669 (Hampton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 23669 (Hampton) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
